project.name: eWalletING (reactor)
project.description: Aggregator only — lets an IDE (or `mvn` from the repo root) discover every module in one go. Deliberately not a parent POM: each module keeps its own spring-boot-starter-parent and manages its own dependency versions, so services stay independently buildable/deployable, matching how they're consumed in practice (see NOTES.md — each SOAP consumer generates its own client stubs rather than sharing a library).
